member.name: T:Api.Controllers.RepoSecretController
member.summary: Manages the secret key/value set attached to a repository.
member.remarks:
Routing and envelopes only. Every rule - validation, tenant scope, status, audit - lives in and the secrets package beneath it, and domain failures reach the client through SecretExceptionFilter rather than through try/catch here.
Every action is keyed on a repository id. None accepts a secret id, so a caller cannot address a secret that does not belong to a repository their tenant can see.
